releaseNotes: Combined original-X4 test candidate: CrossInk 1.6.0 with Anki cloze/paging/four-button grading, reading history/WPM/goals/112 achievements, PDF/FB2 and PDF image zoom, timezone detection, optional delayed power-off, and signed private OTA with battery gating/readback verification. Preserves legacy statistics/positions on import. Full card-image/audio playback and migration of every old setting/bookmark/annotation format are not included. Original-X4 build and 90 host tests passed; physical boot/UI/Wi-Fi/OTA acceptance pending. Keep SD backups before testing or downgrade.
